steps.title: Analyze Build Error

steps.title: Sanitize Gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Remove unneeded external dependencies to comply with strict native SDK guidelines.

steps.title: Verify Color and Style Resources
steps.description: Ensure metric card styles and theme color references match resource declarations.

steps.description: Validate SQLite tables for inventory, transactions, customers, and ledger balances.

steps.title: Verify Financial Models
steps.description: Review Product, Sale, Customer, and Expense data objects for runtime integrity.

steps.title: Verify Profit Calculation Engine
steps.description: Confirm offline deterministic formulas for Gross Profit, Net Profit, and margin percentages.

steps.title: Verify POS Billing Logic
steps.description: Check cart management, atomic inventory decrement, and receipt sharing.

steps.title: Verify Customer Ledger System
steps.description: Ensure accurate tracking of credit dues and customer settlement logging.

steps.title: Verify Expense Tracking and P&L Breakdown
steps.description: Confirm real-time calculation and CSV export for store financial reporting.

steps.title: AAPT2 Resource Compilation Test
steps.description: Validate that layout XML files pass resource linking and compilation without syntax errors.

steps.title: Building DukaanProfit
steps.description: Compile the complete offline application and ensure all modules pass verification.
